# Digital Stamp

A trust indicator that confirms users are interacting with a verified and secure Saudi government source. The component renders as a thin notification bar across the top of a page; tapping "How you know?" expands it to show verification cards (URL extension + HTTPS) and the DGA registration record. Modeled on Figma frames 17504:520 (main) and 25079:5361 (extension variants).

**Stylesheet:** `components/digital-stamp/digital-stamp.css`

**Behaviour:** `js/components/digital-stamp.js` (classes `DigitalStamp`). Without it the markup renders but does not open, close or toggle.

Layout wrappers named `showcase-*` belong to the documentation page, not to the component: leave them out.

## Props / Configuration

All available CSS classes and the high-level slots that compose a stamp.

| Class | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `.digital-stamp` | Required | Base container. Holds the collapsed bar and (when opened) the verification cards + registration card. |
| `.digital-stamp--opened` | State | Expands the stamp to show the extension and registration sections. |
| `.digital-stamp--mobile` | Modifier | Switches the bar to the compact mobile layout where the toggle button drops below the flag + text row. |
| `.digital-stamp--rtl` | Modifier | Right-to-left layout. Equivalent to setting dir="rtl" on the element. |
| `.digital-stamp__content` | Slot | The collapsed-state bar: .digital-stamp__flag, .digital-stamp__text, and .digital-stamp__toggle. |
| `.digital-stamp__flag` | Slot | Small Saudi flag indicator at the leading edge of the bar. |
| `.digital-stamp__text` | Slot | The short attestation sentence. |
| `.digital-stamp__toggle` | Slot | The "How you know?" link button with chevron. Rotates 180° when opened via the existing .digital-stamp__toggle-icon rule. |
| `.digital-stamp__extension` | Slot | Container for the two verification cards. Only visible when .digital-stamp--opened is present. |
| `.digital-stamp__verification-card` | Slot | A single icon + title + description verification card (used twice in the extension section). |
| `.digital-stamp__registration` | Slot | The DGA registration row at the bottom of the opened stamp. |
| `data-card-expandable` | JS hook | Not required — stamps register automatically via initDigitalStamps() on the .digital-stamp selector. |

## Anatomy

The collapsed bar has three parts: the Saudi flag indicator, the attestation text, and the "How you know?" toggle. Tapping the toggle reveals two verification cards (URL extension and HTTPS) and the DGA registration record.

```html
<div class="digital-stamp">
    <div class="digital-stamp__content">
        <div class="digital-stamp__flag">
            <span class="dga-icon-flag-01" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        </div>
        <p class="digital-stamp__text">A government website registered with the Digital Government Authority.
        </p>
        <button type="button" class="digital-stamp__toggle">
            <span>How you know?</span>
            <span class="digital-stamp__toggle-icon">
                <span class="dga-icon-arrow-down-01" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            </span>
        </button>
    </div>
</div>
```

## Opened State

Click the toggle below to expand the stamp. The opened state reveals two verification cards side-by-side (URL extension and HTTPS) and a registration row with the DGA logo and a link to the registration record. The chevron rotates 180°.

```html
<div class="digital-stamp digital-stamp--opened">
    <div class="digital-stamp__content">
        <div class="digital-stamp__flag">
            <span class="dga-icon-flag-01" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        </div>
        <p class="digital-stamp__text">A government website registered with the Digital Government Authority.
        </p>
        <button type="button" class="digital-stamp__toggle" aria-expanded="true">
            <span>How you know?</span>
            <span class="digital-stamp__toggle-icon">
                <span class="dga-icon-arrow-down-01" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            </span>
        </button>
    </div>

    <div class="digital-stamp__extension">
        <div class="digital-stamp__verification-card">
            <div class="digital-stamp__verification-icon">
                <span class="dga-icon-link-01" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            </div>
            <div class="digital-stamp__verification-text">
                <p class="digital-stamp__verification-title">Official Saudi Government websites URL ends with
                    <span class="highlight">.gov.sa</span></p>
                <p class="digital-stamp__verification-description">Website belongs to an official government
                    organization in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia always ends with .gov.sa.</p>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="digital-stamp__verification-card">
            <div class="digital-stamp__verification-icon">
                <span class="dga-icon-security-check" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            </div>
            <div class="digital-stamp__verification-text">
                <p class="digital-stamp__verification-title">Official Secure websites use <span class="highlight">HTTPS</span></p>
                <p class="digital-stamp__verification-description">Ensure the website is using the HTTPS
                    protocol.</p>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="digital-stamp__registration">
        <div class="digital-stamp__registration-content">
            <div class="digital-stamp__dga-logo">
                <span class="dga-icon-checkmark-badge-01" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            </div>
            <div class="digital-stamp__registration-text">
                <p class="digital-stamp__registration-label">Registered on Digital Government Authority:</p>
                <a href="#" class="digital-stamp__registration-link">20230103200</a>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
```

## Mobile Layout

The compact mobile bar drops the "How you know?" toggle below the flag + text row to fit narrow viewports. When opened, the verification cards stack vertically instead of sitting side-by-side. Triggered by .digital-stamp--mobile.

```html
<div style="max-width: 390px; width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--gray-200); border-radius: var(--radius-md); overflow: hidden;">
    <div class="digital-stamp digital-stamp--mobile">
        <div class="digital-stamp__content">
            <div class="digital-stamp__content">
                <div class="digital-stamp__flag">
                    <span class="dga-icon-flag-01" aria-hidden="true"></span>
                </div>
                <p class="digital-stamp__text">A government website registered with the Digital Government
                    Authority.</p>
            </div>
            <button type="button" class="digital-stamp__toggle"><span>How you know?</span><span class="digital-stamp__toggle-icon">
                    <span class="dga-icon-arrow-down-01" aria-hidden="true"></span>
                </span></button>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>


<div style="max-width: 390px; width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--gray-200); border-radius: var(--radius-md); overflow: hidden;">
```

## RTL Support

Arabic and other right-to-left layouts mirror the bar so the flag sits at the trailing edge, the "How you know?" link reads from the right, and the verification cards reverse direction. Triggered by .digital-stamp--rtl or dir="rtl".

```html
<div class="digital-stamp digital-stamp--opened digital-stamp--rtl" dir="rtl">
    <div class="digital-stamp__content">
        <div class="digital-stamp__flag">
            <span class="dga-icon-flag-01" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        </div>
        <p class="digital-stamp__text">موقع حكومي مسجل لدى هيئة الحكومة الرقمية.</p>
        <button type="button" class="digital-stamp__toggle" aria-expanded="true"><span>كيف تتحقق؟</span><span class="digital-stamp__toggle-icon">
                <span class="dga-icon-arrow-down-01" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            </span></button>
    </div>
    <div class="digital-stamp__extension">
        <div class="digital-stamp__verification-card">
            <div class="digital-stamp__verification-icon">
                <span class="dga-icon-link-01" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            </div>
            <div class="digital-stamp__verification-text">
                <p class="digital-stamp__verification-title">روابط المواقع الإلكترونية الرسمية الحكومية تنتهي
                    بـ <span class="highlight">.gov.sa</span></p>
                <p class="digital-stamp__verification-description">جميع روابط المواقع الرسمية التابعة للجهات
                    الحكومية في المملكة العربية السعودية تنتهي بـ .gov.sa</p>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="digital-stamp__verification-card">
            <div class="digital-stamp__verification-icon">
                <span class="dga-icon-security-check" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            </div>
            <div class="digital-stamp__verification-text">
                <p class="digital-stamp__verification-title">المواقع الإلكترونية الحكومية الموثوقة تستخدم
                    بروتوكول <span class="highlight">HTTPS</span></p>
                <p class="digital-stamp__verification-description">تحقق من أن الموقع يستخدم بروتوكول HTTPS</p>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="digital-stamp__registration">
        <div class="digital-stamp__registration-content">
            <div class="digital-stamp__dga-logo">
                <span class="dga-icon-checkmark-badge-01" aria-hidden="true"></span>
            </div>
            <div class="digital-stamp__registration-text">
                <p class="digital-stamp__registration-label">مسجل لدى هيئة الحكومة الرقمية برقم:</p>
                <a href="#" class="digital-stamp__registration-link">20230103200</a>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
```
